title: Repetition code, distance 9 on stationary_chain — no transport at all
claim: one trap holding everything: the breakeven baseline

marks.label: cool
marks.note: the lattice cools too; 13% of its round.

marks.label: the busiest shuttle (1 ions) / a typical shuttle / 1 directions at once
marks.note: the most ions this router ever moves at once, against a ring rotation's 144. The mean is 1.0. The device declares 18 SIMD classes (row and column shifts); the router issues only `shuttle`.  ALSO: a handful of ions, each on its own route: the 80% of this round that is transport is made of instructions like this one.  ALSO: ions moving 1 different ways in one instruction. A ring rotation asks for one. On the 32-channel broadcast block this needs 1 channels -- legal, and the reason q06h's 'a lattice cannot use broadcast' was withdrawn.
